card.architecture: Deterministic OKLab palette + grid quantizer (no model) — PixelQuantize node (ComfyUI-PixelHarness)
card.summary: Snaps an input image onto a fixed grid + palette in OKLab (median-per-cell by default; mode/box/nearest_present selectable). No model, no VRAM. The model-free pixelizer and authoritative final renderer for the pixel-art pipeline.
use_cases: frame-by-frame quantization for animation (temporally consistent via a locked palette)
final palette/grid render after a diffusion pass
card.pick_when: Deterministic pixelization onto a known grid + palette, no diffusion redraw.
